candidates.change_summary: Replace the paused() getter to return the negation of the internal _paused flag, causing paused() to return the opposite value.
Replace the paused() getter to always return true, regardless of the internal _paused flag.
Replace the paused() getter to always return false, ignoring the internal _paused flag.
Require caller is LRT admin by checking role before updating lrtConfig (adds explicit access check using IAccessControl.hasRole and reverts if not admin).
Remove the NonZeroAddress check so updateLRTConfig can accept the zero address and set lrtConfig to zero address.
Change onlyLRTAdmin to check a different role (MANAGER) instead of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, altering who is authorized to call updateLRTConfig.
Make onlyLRTAdmin always allow calls (remove role check), so updateLRTConfig can be called by anyone.
Set maxNodeDelegatorCount to 0 instead of 10 in C.initialize, so post-initialize value differs.
After original assignments, increment maxNodeDelegatorCount by 1, making initialized value 11 instead of 10.
Omit setting maxNodeDelegatorCount so it remains default (0) instead of being set to 10.

Change initializer to set _initialized = 2 instead of 1, causing initializer to mark contract as initialized with different version and preventing body from running in some upgrade patterns (affects whether initialize sets maxNodeDelegatorCount); this changes observable post-initialize state in some call sequences.
